title: Nell Flies to the Bloom
checkpoint: Reception Summer 1, week 2 — Phase 4: CCVC words: two consonant sounds together at the start (no new sounds)
note_for_grown_ups: Non-fiction, Phase 3 complete and Phase 4 begins, 54-sound stage (bl, br, cl, cr just added). Simple true facts about bees visiting flowers, told through Nell.

pages.text: Nell has black marks. Nell can buzz.
pages.illustration: Close view of Nell the bee's body, showing clear black stripe marks, wings blurred mid-buzz.

pages.text: Nell can buzz to a bright bloom.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee flying towards a large bright yellow flower bloom in a garden.

pages.text: Nell can land on a twig.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee landing on a thin green twig just beside the bright bloom.

pages.text: Nell has a job. Nell gets stuff off the bloom.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee reaching into the centre of the bright yellow bloom, collecting pale yellow dust on her legs.
Nell the bee flying away from the bloom, pale yellow dust visible on her legs.

pages.text: Nell can buzz back to her pals.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee flying towards a cluster of other bees waiting near a tree hollow.

pages.text: Nell has a bit of the stuff.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee sharing the pale yellow dust from her legs with another bee.
Nell the bee flying off again above the garden, wings a blur.

pages.text: Nell has fun in the bright, clear sun.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee hovering happily over the garden under a bright, clear blue sky.
